decorative_artwork.model_identifier_note: The generation tool did not expose a model identifier.
decorative_artwork.prompt: Create a polished wide cinematic decorative background illustration for the Minerva Blueprints software architecture project, belonging to the Olympus Project. Ultra-wide banner composition about 3:1, target1600x534. Deep midnight navy #061525 and restrained blue/cyan/teal light with tiny fine gold accents, elegant premium scientific editorial realism. The LEFT 47 percent must stay very dark and calm with only a subtle atmosphere, completely empty of objects so editorial text and an existing logo can later be overlaid. Concentrate all meaningful artwork on the RIGHT 53 percent, full scene safely inside right area: several translucent glass blueprint sheets floating in an isometric stack above a dark drafting surface, delicate abstract geometric model diagrams with nodes and connecting lines etched in cyan and white, a refined brass drafting compass and small architect ruler, a softly luminous crystalline geometric model rising from the sheets. Evoke design, precise modeling, a verification plan and Minerva's wisdom without any figures or gods. Tiny teal particles and faint distant celestial dust create continuity with an elegant scientific atlas banner. Keep clean silhouettes, depth, exquisite details, low glare. The overall canvas should remain navy, no large bright white areas. No logos, no text, no letters, no readable numbers, no title, no watermarks, no pseudo code, no screenshots. No owls or helmet because the supplied brand logo will be placed separately. Image is decorative only, not an actual technical diagram.
decorative_artwork.processing: Copied from the generated PNG without raster editing. The banner SVG scales and clips it to 1600×534.
decorative_artwork.semantics: Decoration only; not a normative or machine-readable program diagram.
decorative_artwork.regeneration_note: The retained PNG is the reproducible input. Repeating the generative prompt may produce different artwork.

diagrams.authoring: Native editable SVG text, geometry and connectors, composed by render_images.py. No generated imagery in the technical diagrams.

diagrams.minerva_state_alignment: The Minerva diagram follows the edition schema: source.state planned/observed; document.nature designed/reconstructed/mixed. Observed source metadata is not proof of execution.

quality_review.note: The two changed model diagrams were rendered with CairoSVG 2.8.2 on Windows and visually inspected for bilingual text, spacing and connectors. The other six renders remain byte-identical to the supplied baseline and passed decoding and recorded-hash checks. This is presentation/source-integrity review, not application conformance.
